subject: Close timeline: guardrails, procurement bridge, and MAP updates
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Tim Bryant <tim.bryant@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Revised MAP draft + timeline options (evaluation delays)

Tim —

Thanks again for the session yesterday. Based on the evaluation notes and the outstanding security questionnaire items, I pulled together a lightly updated mutual action plan (attached) that includes two timeline scenarios:

- Fast path: complete outstanding security responses + procurement sign by Jan 28, target close Feb 4.
- Bridge path: procurement needs extra approvals; plan for a 3-week slip with staged go-live milestones (security gating + feature parity).

I attached MAP_v2.xlsx with checkpoints, owners, and acceptance criteria for the evaluation gates. Can you confirm which path procurement expects, or send the earliest date you can commit to for signatures?

If procurement needs a formal SOW to start internal approvals I can push a draft today.

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP draft)

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
(650) 555-0142

From: Tim Bryant <tim.bryant@acme.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Revised MAP draft + timeline options (evaluation delays)

Hannah —

Thanks for the MAP, I reviewed with procurement and security this morning. Two quick notes:

1) Procurement has a vendor review window that pushes signature authority to the Jan 31 committee; barring a formal SOW and pricing confirmation they won't be able to sign before then.
2) Security still has two open items on data residency and SOC-2 evidence; they expect to close those in ~10 business days after we get the requested artifacts.

Given those constraints, we expect the close to slip. Tentatively please plan for a target close around Feb 11. If you can provide the SOW and the SOC-2 report we can shorten the committee review, but I can't promise earlier than Feb 11 today.

On the MAP, procurement asked for a short stub they can hand to the committee that highlights payment terms, service hours, and an acceptance checklist. Can you produce that?

Thanks —
Tim
Tim Bryant
Director, Platform Engineering — Acme Corporation

Appreciate the update. I'm attaching a short procurement starter packet (procurement_starter.pdf) that includes:
- One-page SOW skeleton
- Standard payment terms and Net30 options
- High-level security artifacts list (what we can provide immediately)

Laura, looping you in to confirm we can deliver the SOC-2 excerpt and the signed data processing addendum by end of next week. If procurement needs a committee-ready stub, see page 2 of the attached packet — it is formatted for committee review.

We will also draft the SOW template and send a DocuSign link.

Attachments: procurement_starter.pdf

Thanks —
Rishi

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 08:25:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: risk note + escalation ask — ACME-2027-042

Team —

Quick internal note to capture risk and next steps before I respond to Tim.

Risk register excerpt (summary):
- Risk: Procurement committee window (low control) — Impact: schedule slip to mid-February — Mitigation: provide committee-ready SOW and compact MAP stub; request procurement lead to include our stub on Jan 31 agenda.
- Risk: Security evidence timing (moderate control) — Impact: evaluation gating; Mitigation: deliver SOC-2 excerpt + data residency note by Jan 21; offer a short security office-hours session with our security engineer.
- Risk: Pricing/contract negotiation (low control) — Impact: need for extended discount or credits to keep business case intact — Mitigation: request 30-day credit extension from Sales Ops + finance if close slips past Feb 4.

Action items:
1) Rishi: finalize procurement_starter.pdf deliverable and SOW skeleton (today EOD).
2) Laura: confirm security artifact delivery timeline and set up a 30-minute sync with Acme security (target Mon 1/18).
3) Hannah: request formal approval to offer a one-time credit extension and conditional staging plan to keep the commitment from product leadership.

I think we should escalate a single ask to SalesOps/Finance for a 30-day credit extension if the close moves beyond Feb 4 — I will draft the escalation note.

Hannah

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tim Bryant <tim.bryant@acme.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Jan 2027 11:50:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: staged acceptance + procurement bridge proposal

Tim —

Thanks for the transparency. To meet both procurement governance and your engineering evaluation needs, here's a short "procurement bridge" proposal:

1) Staged acceptance gates (mapped to the MAP):
   - Gate A (security artifacts delivered): acceptance testing begins (owner: Acme Security).
   - Gate B (evaluation acceptance): feature/latency acceptance window (owner: Acme Eng).
   - Gate C (contract & payment): procurement sign-off and billing start.

2) Temporary bridge terms while procurement committee meets:
   - We can provide a 30-day credit extension and hold pricing for 45 days from Jan 18 if Acme signs the staged MAP acceptance by Jan 25.
   - Staging: allow production preview for a constrained set of users during Gate B; billing pauses until Gate C.

3) Deliverables we will supply this week:
   - SOW draft (SOW_template.docx)
   - SOC-2 excerpt and data residency note (we will route via secure link)
   - Committee-ready one-page MAP stub (page attached in MAP_v2.xlsx)

If this aligns with procurement's needs we can send the DocuSign bundle (SOW + DPA) and a single-page Seller summary for the committee. Please confirm acceptance of the bridge terms so we can prepare the DocuSign envelope.

Regards —
Laura Bennett
Head of Program Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Tim Bryant <tim.bryant@acme.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: staged acceptance + procurement bridge proposal

Laura / Hannah / Rishi —

Appreciate the pragmatic approach. Acme is willing to accept the staged acceptance gates and the 30-day credit extension proposal, provided the staged MAP stub and SOW are submitted to procurement before Jan 25 for committee review.

Request: please send the DocuSign bundle with the SOW + DPA + one-page MAP stub and a short seller summary. Once procurement has the packet we will push it to the Jan 31 committee and aim for an expedited review — if the committee approves we will sign and target close for Feb 11.

I will also schedule a short security sync on Jan 18 to review the SOC-2 excerpt.

Thanks —
Tim
